about.title: Alena Kovalevskaya — EFIRALE perfumer
about.description: I am a perfumer and a former doctor. That is why I pay as much attention to the formula as to the scent itself: clean compositions, raw materials from Grasse (France) and carefully measured dosages. In my studio in Batumi I create signature fragrances and bespoke compositions — and I love watching you listen to the notes.

bespoke.title: Bespoke fragrance
bespoke.description: A fragrance created around your preferences — unique and one of a kind. For yourself, as a gift or for your business.
bespoke.step1_text: Tell me which scents and notes you love, who the perfume is for and what mood it should convey.
bespoke.step2_text: Come to the studio in Batumi: you listen to the notes while I watch your reactions and build the composition for you.
bespoke.step3_text: A finished fragrance made with French raw materials from Grasse. You can always come back for a second bottle.
bespoke.quote: “Perfume does not like to be rushed”
bespoke.work1_text: A bespoke work for a man: a fragrance created around his preferences.
bespoke.work2_text: Orange zest, mango, white peach and pineapple on a base of rum, cane sugar and vanilla — the scent of a carefree summer.
bespoke.work3_text: Pink pepper, heliotrope and powdery wisteria, sandalwood, musks and amber. A client came back for a second bottle.
bespoke.wa_message: Hello! I would like to book a testing session and create a bespoke fragrance.
